warnings: These notes are the project-wide structural spec and apply to BOTH buildings in the set.

Item 1 gives concrete grade ค2 fc' = 200 ksc (cylinder) and item 2 gives round bar SR-24 fy = 2400 ksc -- these are the concrete_grade/steel_grade values that should be joined onto every RC element (footings, pedestals, slabs) in this house.
Item 3 governs the STEEL superstructure (ASTM-A36), which is why beams/columns on S-02 carry steel_section and not main_bar (spec §6a).
Item 4 explains the dual footing type drawn on the footing plans (spread vs pile, chosen by soil bearing capacity of 8 t/m²).
